readout_other: local field potential in CA1: theta and gamma power, theta-gamma phase-amplitude coupling
direction_notes: TUS increased theta and gamma absolute power and theta-gamma PAC under anaesthesia and awake states but not (PAC decreased) in the running state; relative power trends with intensity were state dependent.

exposures.label: TUS of CA1, anaesthesia, awake and running states

timing.protocol_description: 16 trials per animal; each trial 400 ms stimulation duration at 1 kHz PRF and 50% duty cycle. Intensity 0.45 MPa for the theta/gamma comparison across states; five intensities for the intensity series.

source_quotes.n_subjects: Forty-two C57BL/6 mice were used in these experiments

flags.reason: 42 mice in total: 21 for state comparison, 21 for the intensity series (7 per state in each).
Pulse duration not stated; 400 ms is the stimulation duration (train), not the pulse.
Intensities given in MPa without stating whether water or in situ; converted 0.15-0.75 MPa to kPa. Focused beam at about 45 degrees into the brain.
Transducer not described; refers to previous papers.
0.5% isoflurane in the anaesthesia group; awake and running groups head-fixed without anaesthesia.
